title: Learn a craft at John C. Campbell Folk School

location.label: John C. Campbell Folk School, Brasstown, North Carolina

description: Choose a class in Brasstown and spend a weekend or a week working with your hands. The Folk School offers subjects from blacksmithing and weaving to music, cooking, and writing. Instructors guide the work, while meals and informal gatherings give you time with people who came to learn something new too.
teaser: Trade your usual routine for days of making and learning.
goodToKnow: Choose a current class and check its physical demands, accommodation and meal arrangements.
whyItMightDelightYou: You can be a beginner here and still leave with a new skill and a sense of belonging.
